cheats.name: Infinite\99 Health Potions
cheats.note: Do Not put this cheat on until you have collected your 1st Health Potion from the 1st Cheat or you will not be able to get into the Sub menu and Continue the game.

cheats.name: Have\Max Total XP Remaning to Start
cheats.note: This will give you 16777215 Total XP Remaning to start with and after your 1st batle will allow you to buy your Max Stats

cheats.name: Play As Character
cheats.note: Enable this at the start of a Game, before a next Level, or before a Cutscene to become your chosen option.
